A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same A-TPT research work, with 23 readable pages including Appendix A.1–A.20. Text comparison and page rendering establish identical substantive content; visible differences are confined to the first-page arXiv version/date stamp.

before.justification: v1 reports original A-TPT accuracy and calibration experiments on classification, distribution-shift and medical datasets (Tables 2–7), with additional empirical analyses in the appendix.

after.justification: v2 retains these original experimental results, including the main benchmark comparisons and appendix experiments on seeds, prompt initialization and combined regularizers.

M1.justification: The angular-diversity regularizer and joint test-time prompt-tuning objective in Section 3, Equations (1)–(2), are identical. No algorithm, model component or inference procedure changes.

E1.justification: Section 4 and Appendix A.8 retain the same classification datasets, ImageNet distribution-shift variants and medical evaluations on ISIC 2018, KatherColon and Covid. No dataset or task scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in every corresponding experiment, including the baseline, TPT, C-TPT and O-TPT comparisons, CoOp/CoCoOp evaluations, and medical comparisons involving FPT, PromptSmooth and BAPLe.

E3.justification: The backbones, dataset sizes, accuracy/ECE/SCE metrics, prompt configurations and experimental procedures are identical. Section 4 and Appendix A.10 retain the same optimization settings and regularization weights.

E4.justification: The feature visualizations, distribution-shift tests, reliability analyses, prompt-initialization comparisons, combined-regularizer experiment and regularization-weight Pareto analysis are all retained unchanged, including Appendix A.12–A.20.

E5.justification: Appendix A.13 and Table 12 report the same standard deviations from three runs with different seeds across five datasets. No run-count or uncertainty-reporting practice changes.

E6.justification: All numerical entries and plotted findings match, including appendix results. For example, Table 2 reports A-TPT average ECE of 2.61 with ViT-B/16 and 2.92 with RN50 in both PDFs.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions and objectives, Appendix A.6 gradient derivations, and Appendix A.7 complexity analysis are identical. No assumption, derivation or theoretical argument is added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction contributions and conclusion retain identical claims about angular diversity, improved calibration, comparable accuracy, distribution-shift performance and medical generalization.

C2.justification: The explanations connecting angular separation to calibration are unchanged. Appendix A.4 retains the same limitations concerning occasional accuracy reductions, difficult hyperparameter selection and a fixed regularization weight.

D1.justification: Appendix A.10 retains the same AdamW optimizer, single update, learning rate, batch size and GPU disclosure. Dataset details, resource measurements and the statement that code will be made publicly available are unchanged.

R1.justification: The references and related-work discussion are identical, including positioning against C-TPT and O-TPT and motivation from the Tammes problem and ArcFace.

P1.justification: The first-page arXiv margin stamp changes from v1 dated 30 Oct 2025 to v2 dated 26 Jan 2026. Body wording, title, authors, headings and document organization remain identical.

P2.justification: Figures 1–14, Tables 1–16, captions and page layout are unchanged. Pages 2–23 render identically; the first-page difference is limited to the margin-stamp text.

improvement.justification: v2 preserves the complete scientific content, empirical evidence, appendix analyses and presentation of v1. Updating the arXiv version/date stamp and its corresponding link does not meaningfully improve or diminish the paper's quality.
